model.description: Betty's Eddies Raspberry Creme Bedtime Betty's chews deliver a balanced 1:2:1 THC:CBD:CBN ratio of cannabinoids in a 50 mg edible designed to help you unwind. Crafted by Betty's Eddies, these indica-inspired chews combine relaxing effects with the sweet, creamy flavor of raspberry for a delicious bedtime treat. Each chew offers a smooth, fruity taste that makes your nightly routine something to look forward to. Ideal for those seeking relief and relaxation, Bedtime Betty's help ease you into a restful state, promoting sleepy, calm vibes perfect for winding down after a long day. The convenient chewable format makes dosing simple and enjoyable, while the raspberry creme flavor profile adds a touch of indulgence to your cannabis experience. Whether you're looking to quiet a busy mind or simply enhance your sleep quality, these indica chews provide a gentle, effective way to embrace relaxation and drift off peacefully.
